headline: This 2015 Porsche 918 Spyder is Now Available at duPont REGISTRY Select!
overview: Finished in Racing Yellow over a Mocha Brown leather interior, this 2015 Porsche 918 Spyder represents one of the rarest known specifications of Porsche's groundbreaking hybrid hypercar. It is said to be one of only eight Racing Yellow examples produced and reportedly the only Racing Yellow 918 Spyder configured with a Mocha Brown interior, making it an exceptionally collectible example. Powered by a 4.6-liter naturally aspirated V8 paired with dual electric motors, the 918 Spyder produces a combined 887 horsepower and features Porsche's advanced hybrid technology, carbon fiber monocoque construction and all-wheel drive. Widely regarded as one of the most significant hypercars of the modern era, the 918 Spyder delivers extraordinary performance while remaining one of the most desirable vehicles ever produced by Porsche.
